mission: Leap 2 - Memory Architecture Refactoring at Scale

tasks.title: Spec: Current Memory Architecture Analysis
tasks.description: Analyze current memory architecture (VectorStore, Memory Tool, Session) and identify performance bottlenecks, redundancies, and optimization opportunities. Document current state with metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Document all 3 memory tiers with current performance metrics
Identify top 5 performance bottlenecks with quantitative data
Map current memory flows across all 10 agents
Define success metrics for refactoring (latency, throughput, memory usage)

tasks.title: Spec: VectorStore Optimization Strategy
tasks.description: Design VectorStore optimization strategy focusing on indexing, query performance, and memory efficiency. Include batch processing and caching strategies.
acceptance_criteria: Define indexing strategy for semantic search optimization
Specify batch processing approach for bulk memory operations
Design caching layer with eviction policy
Include memory budget constraints (M4 Pro 48GB target)

tasks.title: Spec: Memory Tool Async Refactoring
tasks.description: Design async/await patterns for Memory Tool operations to enable parallel memory reads/writes across agents. Define concurrency control mechanisms.
acceptance_criteria: Specify async API surface for all Memory Tool operations
Define concurrency control (locks, semaphores) for file operations
Include error handling for async operations
Design parallel read strategy for multi-agent scenarios

tasks.title: Spec: Session State Management Optimization
tasks.description: Design efficient session state management with minimal memory footprint. Include state compression, serialization, and garbage collection strategies.
acceptance_criteria: Define session state schema with compression strategy
Specify garbage collection policy for expired sessions
Include serialization format (JSON/MessagePack/Protobuf comparison)
Design state persistence for multi-day tasks

tasks.title: Implement VectorStore Indexing Layer
tasks.description: Implement semantic indexing layer for VectorStore using FAISS or similar. Add support for batch indexing and incremental updates.
acceptance_criteria: FAISS integration with pickle persistence
Batch indexing API for bulk memory additions
Incremental update support without full rebuild
Query performance <100ms for 10K embeddings

tasks.title: Implement VectorStore Caching Layer
tasks.description: Add LRU caching layer for frequently accessed memories. Implement cache warming and eviction strategies.
acceptance_criteria: LRU cache with configurable size (default 1000 entries)
Cache warming on startup from top 100 accessed patterns
Eviction metrics logging (hit/miss ratio)
Thread-safe cache implementation

tasks.title: Implement Batch Memory Operations
tasks.description: Add batch store/search APIs to VectorStore for parallel agent operations. Optimize embedding generation for batches.
acceptance_criteria: batch_store_memories(List[Memory]) API
batch_search_memories(List[Query]) API with parallel execution
Batch embedding generation (single OpenAI call)
10x throughput improvement for batch operations

tasks.title: Test VectorStore Refactoring
tasks.description: Comprehensive AAA tests for VectorStore indexing, caching, and batch operations. Include performance benchmarks.
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests for indexing (happy path + edge cases)
Cache hit/miss tests with metrics validation
Batch operation tests (10, 100, 1000 items)
Performance regression tests (<100ms query, 10x batch speedup)

tasks.title: Implement Async Memory Tool API
tasks.description: Refactor Memory Tool to async/await pattern. Add asyncio support for all file operations (create, view, edit, delete).
acceptance_criteria: All Memory Tool methods converted to async def
aiofiles integration for async file I/O
Backward compatibility wrapper for sync callers
Async context manager support

tasks.title: Implement Memory Tool Concurrency Control
tasks.description: Add file-level locking for concurrent Memory Tool operations. Implement asyncio.Lock per file path to prevent race conditions.
acceptance_criteria: Per-file asyncio.Lock implementation
Timeout handling for lock acquisition (5s default)
Deadlock detection and logging
Lock contention metrics

tasks.title: Implement Parallel Memory Tool Reads
tasks.description: Add batch_view() API for parallel file reads. Optimize for multi-agent scenarios where 3-5 agents read different memory files simultaneously.
acceptance_criteria: batch_view(List[str]) -> List[str] API
asyncio.gather() for parallel reads
Read-write lock optimization (allow concurrent reads)
3x throughput improvement for parallel reads

tasks.title: Test Async Memory Tool
tasks.description: AAA tests for async Memory Tool operations, concurrency control, and parallel reads. Include stress tests with 10 concurrent agents.
acceptance_criteria: Async operation tests (create, view, edit, delete)
Concurrency tests (10 agents writing to different files)
Race condition tests (2 agents editing same file)
Stress test: 50 parallel reads across 3 workers

tasks.title: Implement Session State Compression
tasks.description: Add zlib compression for session state serialization. Implement compression on save, decompression on load with size metrics.
acceptance_criteria: zlib compression integration in AgentContext.save_state()
Automatic decompression in load_state()
Compression ratio metrics (target 60% size reduction)
Backward compatibility with uncompressed sessions

tasks.title: Implement Session Garbage Collection
tasks.description: Add automatic garbage collection for expired session states. Implement TTL-based cleanup with configurable retention policy.
acceptance_criteria: TTL-based session expiration (default 30 days)
Background cleanup task (runs daily at 2am)
Retention policy for completed vs abandoned sessions
Cleanup metrics logging (sessions deleted, space reclaimed)

tasks.title: Implement Multi-Day Session Persistence
tasks.description: Add checkpoint/resume support for multi-day tasks. Implement incremental state saving with recovery mechanisms.
acceptance_criteria: Checkpoint API: save_checkpoint(checkpoint_id)
Resume API: resume_from_checkpoint(checkpoint_id)
Incremental state saving (delta encoding)
Corruption recovery with last-known-good fallback

tasks.title: Test Session State Optimization
tasks.description: AAA tests for session compression, garbage collection, and multi-day persistence. Include recovery scenarios.
acceptance_criteria: Compression tests (verify 60% size reduction)
GC tests (verify expired sessions deleted)
Checkpoint/resume tests (multi-day task simulation)
Corruption recovery tests (verify fallback to last-known-good)

tasks.title: Refactor AgentContext for Optimized Memory
tasks.description: Integrate all memory optimizations into AgentContext. Ensure all 10 agents use optimized memory APIs seamlessly.
acceptance_criteria: AgentContext uses async Memory Tool by default
VectorStore caching enabled for all agents
Batch operations used in Learning Agent
Session compression enabled in all save_state() calls

tasks.title: Implement Memory Performance Metrics
tasks.description: Add comprehensive metrics collection for all memory operations. Include Prometheus-style metrics for monitoring.
acceptance_criteria: Metrics for VectorStore: query latency, cache hit ratio, batch throughput
Metrics for Memory Tool: file I/O latency, lock contention, parallel reads
Metrics for Session: compression ratio, GC frequency, checkpoint size
Prometheus exporter for real-time monitoring

tasks.title: Test Memory Architecture Integration
tasks.description: End-to-end integration tests for all memory optimizations. Simulate 10 agents working concurrently on shared memory.
acceptance_criteria: 10-agent concurrent memory test (3 workers max)
VectorStore stress test (1000 queries/sec)
Memory Tool stress test (50 parallel file operations)
Session state test (checkpoint/resume across 10 sessions)

tasks.title: Test Performance Benchmarks
tasks.description: Performance regression tests comparing old vs new memory architecture. Validate success metrics from spec_memory_analysis.
acceptance_criteria: VectorStore query latency: <100ms (baseline: 300ms)
Memory Tool parallel reads: 3x throughput improvement
Session state size: 60% reduction via compression
Overall memory usage: <40GB peak (M4 Pro budget)

tasks.title: Spec: Stateful Learning Architecture
tasks.description: Design stateful learning layer that builds on optimized memory architecture. Include agent state persistence, cross-session learning, and adaptive model routing.
acceptance_criteria: Define agent state schema (skills, preferences, history)
Specify cross-session learning mechanism (pattern accumulation)
Design adaptive model routing (P1/P2/P3 learned from history)
Include Leap 3 roadmap with 5 key milestones

tasks.title: Implement Agent State Schema
tasks.description: Implement Pydantic models for agent state persistence. Include skills, preferences, execution history, and learning metadata.
acceptance_criteria: AgentState Pydantic model with typed fields
Skills tracking (successful patterns, failure modes)
Preferences tracking (model choices, tool usage)
Execution history (task count, success rate, cost metrics)

tasks.title: Implement Cross-Session Learning Storage
tasks.description: Add cross-session learning storage using optimized VectorStore. Enable agents to accumulate knowledge across multiple sessions.
acceptance_criteria: AgentContext.accumulate_learning(pattern) API
Cross-session pattern retrieval with confidence scoring
Learning decay mechanism (older patterns weighted lower)
VectorStore integration with agent-specific namespaces

tasks.title: Test Stateful Learning Foundation
tasks.description: AAA tests for agent state schema and cross-session learning. Validate readiness for Leap 3 implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Agent state serialization/deserialization tests
Cross-session learning accumulation tests
Learning decay validation tests
Leap 3 readiness checklist (5/5 items passing)

checkpoints.prompt: Review architecture analysis and optimization specs before implementation. Validate success metrics and design decisions.
Review async Memory Tool implementation before session state optimization. Validate concurrency control and performance.
Review integrated memory architecture and performance benchmarks. Validate readiness for Leap 3 preparation.
